experiences.name: Pirate Water Taxi
experiences.departs_text: Home dock and ticket booth at Stop 7, Convention Center / Marriott Water Street; you can board at any of the 10 stops: 1 Florida Aquarium / American Victory Ship, 2 Sparkman Wharf / Yacht StarShip / Craft, 3 Benchmark International Arena / Tampa History Center, 4 Harbour Island, 7 Convention Center / Marriott Water Street, 8 Tampa General Hospital, 11 Arabelle Riverwalk, 12 Curtis Hixon Waterfront Park, 15 Julian B. Lane Riverfront Park, 16 Armature Works / Ulele.
experiences.price_text: All-Day Pass: Adult $34; Child (ages 2-12) $24. Annual Membership $199.95. Prices are subject to change based on timing and availability.
experiences.schedule_text: Mon-Thu 11:30 a.m.-6:30 p.m.; Fri-Sun 11:30 a.m.-9:30 p.m. Weekday departures from Stop 7 toward Stop 16 at 11:30 AM, 1:00, 2:30, 4:00 and 5:30 PM; more frequent departures Friday-Sunday (see the posted schedule).
experiences.ages_text: Children aged 13 or under must be accompanied by someone 14 years of age or older.
experiences.summary: Hop-on, hop-off water taxi on the Hillsborough River and the Channel District waterfront, with 10 numbered stops from the Florida Aquarium to Armature Works. An all-day pass lets you ride as often as you like; tickets are sold online and at the booth at Stop 7.
experiences.quote: Pirate Water Taxi offers daily tours of Tampa with many stops located along our route near attractions, museums, restaurants & parks!
experiences.notes: FAQ: all water taxis are wheelchair accessible, but not all dock locations are; service is suspended for lightning, heavy rain and high winds; bikes are not allowed on board; only registered service animals. Seasonal extras on its FareHarbor list (Haunted River Tour 'Select Nights in October', Holiday Lighted Boat Parade, New Year's Eve Fireworks) are not separate records. Search snippets quoting $20/$10 fares are outdated; the operator's rates page says $34/$24.

experiences.name: Yacht StarShip Dining Cruises (Tampa)
experiences.departs_text: 603 Channelside Drive, downtown Tampa (Pirate Water Taxi stop 2 is Sparkman Wharf / Yacht StarShip / Craft).
experiences.duration_text: 2-hour cruise (boarding starts 30 minutes prior to sail time)
experiences.price_text: Tampa Dinner Cruise from $79.95 adult, $54.95 child (ages 2-12); cruise-only from $49.95 adult, $29.95 child; under 2 complimentary. Brunch and lunch cruises from $59.95 adult. Prices change.
experiences.schedule_text: Dinner cruise times vary by date; Tampa Brunch Cruise 12:30-2:30 PM on weekends.
experiences.summary: Two-hour dining cruises from downtown Tampa past waterfront mansions and the seaport into Tampa Bay, with a buffet, a DJ and, on select cruises, an included open bar. Brunch, lunch, dinner and themed special-event cruises are offered.
experiences.quote: In Tampa, you'll cruise by million-dollar mansions and Florida's largest seaport, en route to beautiful Tampa Bay.
experiences.notes: Same parent company as Pirate Water Taxi and Lost Pearl (yachtstarship.com/sister-companies/). $6 validated parking at the Channelside Parking Garage per the operator.

experiences.name: Yacht StarShip Dining Cruises (Clearwater Beach)
experiences.departs_text: Clearwater Beach Marina, 25 Causeway Boulevard, Slip #55.
experiences.price_text: Dinner + sunset cruise from $69.95 adult, $49.95 child (ages 2-12); sunset cruise-only from $39.95 adult, $29.95 child; under 2 complimentary. Prices change.
experiences.schedule_text: Sunset cruises generally depart around 30 minutes before sunset; departure times depend on the date.
experiences.summary: Two-hour sunset dinner cruise aboard Yacht StarShip IV on the Intracoastal Waterway off Clearwater Beach, with a buffet, a DJ and an included open bar (four-drink limit on cruise-only tickets).
experiences.quote: In Clearwater, you'll cruise the scenic Intercoastal Waterway viewing million-dollar mansions, an occasional pod of playful dolphins and a scenic West Coast sunset in Clearwater Pass or the Gulf of Mexico, weather permitting.
experiences.notes: Marina works (City of Clearwater marina page, read 2026-09-27): a two-phase replacement expected to be complete in August 2026; 'Tourism boating operations are now in their new slips along Coronado Drive', while the fishing fleet and dinner boats are in temporary locations but fully operational, so slip numbers given by operators may have changed.

experiences.name: Lost Pearl Pirate Cruise
experiences.departs_text: Riverwalk behind the Tampa Convention Center, next to the yellow Pirate Water Taxi ticket booth.
experiences.price_text: Adult: starts at $34.95; Child (ages 2-12): starts at $29.95; plus tax and fees.
experiences.schedule_text: Public cruises Friday-Sunday, plus school holidays and special events; sunset cruises on select dates.
experiences.summary: A 1.5-hour pirate-themed cruise from downtown Tampa for all ages: children train as pirates with games and water-cannon battles while adults can use the full bar (drinks and snacks are extra). The crew looks for dolphins but does not guarantee sightings.
experiences.quote: Come aboard the Lost Pearl for a 1.5-hour pirate adventure out in Tampa Bay! Become a part of our pirate crew with swashbuckling training, water gun battles and more!
experiences.notes: FAQ: wheelchairs cannot roll on board (steps and a 12-foot gangway); cruises run rain or shine with rainchecks. Seasonal cruises on its site: A Pirate's Halloween, A Pirate's Christmas, Holiday Lighted Boat Parade Cruise, New Year's Eve.

experiences.name: Tampa Bay Fun Boat Sightseeing Tour
experiences.departs_text: Tampa Convention Center boat docks, at the seawall in front of the Sail Pavilion at the entrance to the marina.
experiences.price_text: Guests 13 and older $25; children 3-12 $12; children 2 and under free (must be on the reservation).
experiences.schedule_text: Departure times on the operator's calendar; sunset tours also offered.
experiences.summary: A 90-minute public sightseeing tour on a 35-passenger deck boat past Davis Islands and Harbour Island, with narration on local history and homes and a lookout for dolphins. You may bring a small cooler and your own drinks, and pets are welcome.
experiences.quote: On this scenic cruise you will see some of the homes of Tampa's rich and famous as well as learn some of the history of Davis Islands and Harbor Island all while searching for dolphins and other wildlife!

experiences.name: Paddle Pub Tampa
experiences.departs_text: Boards at 333 S Franklin St (Tampa Convention Center docks).
experiences.price_text: Public seat $49; private boat (up to 16 guests) $599; pricing before taxes and fees.
experiences.schedule_text: Daytime, sunset and glow-party cruises; times on the booking calendar.
experiences.summary: A two-hour BYOB cruise on the Hillsborough River aboard a pedal-powered party boat with motor assist, a captain and a deckhand host. Book a single seat on a public cruise or the whole boat for up to 16.
experiences.quote: Cruise Tampa's skyline on Paddle Pub! Bring your drinks, dance to great music, and party with your crew while your deckhand host keeps the energy up with games and prizes, shot ski, karaoke and more!
experiences.notes: FAQ: a 15-20 minute halfway stop, typically at docks near Armature Works and Ulele or Rick's on the River.
experiences.ages_text: Children are not permitted on public cruises; they are welcome on private cruises with a parent or legal guardian over 25.

experiences.name: eBoats Tampa Electric Boat Rentals
experiences.departs_text: Tampa Convention Center marina on the Riverwalk, 333 S Franklin St.
experiences.summary: Self-drive electric boats for up to 10 passengers, rented by the hour or with a guide, from the Tampa Convention Center marina.
experiences.quote: Our boats comfortably fit up to 10 passengers and are available on an hourly basis or with a guide to customize your tour.
experiences.notes: eboatstampa.com returned a bot challenge (HTTP 202) to both curl and WebFetch, so prices, hours and the operator age rule (a search snippet said 23+) are left null; verifier should read the operator's site in a browser.

experiences.name: Riverwalk Boating Company Mini Powerboat and Retro Boat Rentals
experiences.address: 333 S Franklin St, Boat Slip #26, Tampa, FL 33602
experiences.departs_text: Boat Slip #26, 333 S Franklin Street (Tampa Convention Center marina).
experiences.summary: Rents two-person mini powerboats and four-person retro boats that you drive yourself after instruction, plus pontoon rentals with a captain for up to six.
experiences.quote: No boating experience required, with full instruction provided from our friendly crew. Prefer to relax? A Captain is included in our pontoon rentals for up to six guests!
experiences.notes: Verifier 2026-09-27: riverwalkboating.com was read with WebFetch (curl gets a bot challenge); prices, hours, durations and the age rule come from its boat cards and FAQ. Booking page (waverez) lists Mini-Powerboat Rental, Retro Boat Rental (up to 4 people), Private Pontoon Boat Rental with Captain (up to 6 people).
experiences.duration_text: Mini-powerboat and retro boat 1-2 hours; captained pontoon 2 hours
experiences.price_text: Mini-powerboat (2 people) from $89; retro boat (4 people) from $119; private pontoon with captain (up to 6) from $399.
experiences.schedule_text: Open 7 days a week, 10 AM to 30 minutes before sunset; earlier times may be available by phone.
experiences.ages_text: Drivers must be at least 18; passengers can be any age. No boating license needed: bring a government ID and a credit card ($250 pre-authorization hold at check-in).

experiences.name: Adventure Rowing on the Hillsborough River
experiences.departs_text: Boathouse at the Tampa River Center, Julian B. Lane Riverfront Park.
experiences.duration_text: 3 hours (normally 9 a.m. to noon on weekday mornings)
experiences.price_text: $250 per person, with a minimum of 4 participants.
experiences.schedule_text: Normally starts at 9am on weekday mornings; can be customized for groups.
experiences.ages_text: No experience needed; each participant must be able to carry 35 lbs overhead, weigh under 250 lbs and tread water for at least 1 minute.
experiences.summary: A half-day learn-to-row session with coaches: practice on rowing machines, then row an eight-person boat on the Hillsborough River. Small groups may be combined to fill a boat.
experiences.quote: Come experience rowing—an Olympic sport that's both elegant and fun—on the scenic Hillsborough River.

experiences.name: Urban Kai Stand Up Paddleboard Rentals, Tours and Lessons
experiences.departs_text: Urban Kai shop, 310 W 7th Ave, on the Hillsborough River.
experiences.summary: Stand-up paddleboard shop on the Hillsborough River in Tampa that offers board rentals, guided kayak and paddleboard tours, lessons and fitness classes.
experiences.quote: In Tampa and St. Petersburg Florida, Urban Kai Stand Up Paddle Board Shop, the original SUP shop of Tampa, (located on the Hillsborough River) is teaching, touring and offering fitness classes for stand up paddling.
experiences.notes: urbankai.com rental and tour pages load their content by script; neither curl nor WebFetch returned tour names, prices or launch points. Address from Visit Tampa Bay; census geocoder matched the wrong side of the street name (E 7th), so no coordinates.

experiences.name: Hillsborough River Canoe and Kayak Rentals at John B. Sargeant Conservation Park
experiences.departs_text: Park office at John B. Sargeant Sr. Conservation Park, on the Hillsborough River at US 301.
experiences.price_text: Local rental (one park) for up to four hours: $25; each additional hour $10 (fees include tax).
experiences.schedule_text: Canoe and kayak rentals 7 days a week from 8 AM until 1 PM.
experiences.summary: The county rents canoes and kayaks at the park office for paddling the Hillsborough River State Canoe Trail through hardwood swamp downstream, or the wide Seventeen Runs upstream. Rentals may be suspended during small craft advisories.
experiences.quote: Downriver, the Hillsborough River State Canoe Trail winds through a jungle of hardwood trees, lilies, and wading birds and is popular for both new and experienced paddlers.
experiences.notes: Canoe Escape, the private outfitter long based here (12702 N US Hwy 301), is listed as CLOSED on Yelp and its canoeescape.com domain no longer resolves to a site, so it was left out. The county page (modified 8/18/2026) says rentals are at the park office.

experiences.name: Canoe and Kayak Rentals in Hillsborough County Parks
experiences.departs_text: Rent on site at the entry station of E.G. Simmons Park, Edward Medard Park, Lake Conservation Park, Lettuce Lake Park or Upper Tampa Bay Park (the county list marks these with rentals available); John B. Sargeant Conservation Park also rents at its park office.
experiences.price_text: Local rental (one park) for up to four hours: $25; hourly fee for each additional hour: $10; fees include tax.
experiences.summary: Hillsborough County rents canoes and kayaks at several of its parks for paddling rivers, creeks and bay shorelines. Rentals may be suspended or stopped early when small craft advisories are issued.
experiences.quote: Try a leisurely paddle, swift-moving journey, or a bit of an adventure on Hillsborough County's rivers, creeks and waterways.
experiences.notes: Area set to north-tampa for Lettuce Lake Park, the rental park closest to the city; the rental parks are spread across the county, so a single area is approximate. No coordinates because there is no single departure point.

experiences.name: Tampa Bay Ferry (Tampa-St. Petersburg)
experiences.operator: Hubbard's Ferry for the Pinellas Suncoast Transit Authority (PSTA)
experiences.departs_text: Planned docks: Tampa Convention Center in downtown Tampa and the Vinoy Yacht Basin in downtown St. Petersburg.
experiences.duration_text: Expected approximately 45 to 50 minutes each way.
experiences.summary: A planned ferry between downtown Tampa and downtown St. Petersburg that succeeds the former Cross-Bay Ferry. PSTA bought two vessels, Bay Breeze and Clipper, for the service, which Hubbard's will operate.
experiences.status_note: Not yet running as of Sep 27, 2026: the service's own site (tampabayferry.com) says 'SERVICE COMING SOON'. PSTA (June 22, 2026): no launch date confirmed. St. Pete Rising (Aug 18, 2026): launch expected later in 2026 after refurbishment and inspections, seven days a week, one-way fares targeted at $10 with discounts planned for seniors and riders with disabilities; schedule not yet final.
experiences.notes: The getting-around slice likely holds this as transport too. A search summary said the Cross-Bay Ferry ended April 30, 2025 after its operator defaulted; not verified on a primary page, so not stated. crossbayferry.com returned no readable content.

experiences.name: Wild Dolphin Cruise
experiences.departs_text: Launch near the aquarium's Outdoor Plaza; pick up a boarding wristband at Guest Services.
experiences.price_text: $17 per adult; $15 per child (ages 3-11); free for children 2 and under; plus general admission.
experiences.schedule_text: Weekdays: 1:00 PM and 2:30 PM, weather permitting.
experiences.summary: A naturalist-guided cruise on Tampa Bay aboard the aquarium's 72-foot catamaran, Bay Spirit II, looking for bottlenose dolphins and shorebirds. Each rider also needs a same-day aquarium general admission ticket.
experiences.quote: Step aboard the Bay Spirit II, our 72-foot catamaran, where an experienced naturalist will guide you through the natural beauty of the Bay's ecosystem.
experiences.notes: Tickets are non-refundable; the Bay Spirit II has limited accessibility for mobility devices (per the page). Duration not stated on the page (a search snippet said 75 minutes); left null.

experiences.name: Tiki Boat Tampa
experiences.departs_text: The Western Docks at Armature Works, 1910 N Ola Ave.
experiences.duration_text: 90-minute tours; customizable tours up to 4 hours
experiences.ages_text: Family friendly; you must be 21 (ID checked) to bring alcohol.
experiences.summary: A 12-passenger tiki boat with a bathroom on board that tours the Hillsborough River past Davis Island and Harbour Island and back. Groups of 6 to 12 book the boat; you bring your own food and drinks.
experiences.quote: We have a 90 minute tour traveling the Hillsborough River, Davis Island, Harbour Island and back.
experiences.notes: The operator says the boat is wheelchair accessible and ADA compliant and US Coast Guard certified. Price not on the page.

experiences.name: Pirate Tikis Downtown Tampa Tours
experiences.departs_text: Public cruises pick up and drop off at Curtis Hixon Park; private charters can choose other pickup points on the river.
experiences.schedule_text: Daytime and evening tours 7 days per week.
experiences.ages_text: Children may ride only on full-boat charters (not per-seat public tours), supervised by a parent or guardian over 25; children under 13 must wear their own Coast Guard-approved life jacket. Must be 21 to drink alcohol (valid photo ID).
experiences.summary: Floating tiki-bar cruises on the Hillsborough River past Curtis Hixon Park, the University of Tampa, the Straz Center and Armature Works. Book single seats (up to 6 per booking) or the whole boat for up to 13; BYOB, with a cooler, ice and a Bluetooth speaker provided.
experiences.quote: Along with an incredible time on a floating tiki bar, we will provide a cooler with ice and a Bluetooth sound system.
experiences.notes: Address and coordinates are Curtis Hixon Waterfront Park's (600 N Ashley Dr), the public-cruise pickup; the operator's headquarters is 503 East Jackson St. Prices are on the booking system, not on the pages read.

experiences.name: Paramount Water Sports Guided Jet Ski Rides
experiences.address: 601 S Harbour Island Blvd, Tampa, FL 33602
experiences.departs_text: 601 S Harbour Island Blvd (park in The Pointe garage, walk toward the water and the bridge).
experiences.duration_text: 60 or 90 minutes; guided tour of Tampa Bay 2 hours
experiences.price_text: Single rider: 60 minutes $120, 90 minutes $175; tandem: 60 minutes $145, 90 minutes $195 (plus tax). 2-hour guided tour: $299 single, $319 tandem. Sunset Ride & Dine from $185.
experiences.summary: Guide-led jet ski rides from Harbour Island onto Tampa Bay. The two-hour tour passes Davis Islands waterfront homes, the University of Tampa and downtown and includes an island stop.
experiences.quote: Have a Certified Guide lead you or your group out to the bay to enjoy an exciting ride on the ocean, all while seeing beautiful views of the Davis Island Waterfront mansions, the University of Tampa, and the Downtown Business District.

experiences.name: Wet Rentals & Tours at the Westin Tampa Bay
experiences.address: 7627 W Courtney Campbell Cswy, Tampa, FL 33607
experiences.departs_text: Westin Tampa Bay, 7627 W. Courtney Campbell Causeway.
experiences.summary: Jet ski and JetCar rentals on Tampa Bay by the Courtney Campbell Causeway, plus paddleboard and kayak rentals at this location.
experiences.quote: Conveniently located at the Westin Tampa Bay on the scenic Courtney Campbell Causeway, our team offers everything from high-speed freestyle jet skiing to relaxing paddleboard sessions.
experiences.notes: Wet Rentals & Tours also lists Clearwater and St. Petersburg locations. Prices not on the page.

experiences.name: Latitudes Tours Eco Tours, Dinner Cruises and Kayak Tours
experiences.departs_text: Park at 620 Bahia Beach Blvd (Little Harbor, Ruskin) and board at the white gated ramp.
experiences.schedule_text: Daily tours Tuesday through Sunday: morning eco tours, 12:30 eco tours with optional lunch, sunset cruises with dinner, guided kayak tours.
experiences.summary: Narrated boat tours from Ruskin on the south shore of Tampa Bay through the bay estuary and the Little Manatee River, looking for dolphins, manatees and birds, with optional lunch or dinner; guided kayak tours too.
experiences.quote: Join our expert captain and naturalist for a captivating 2-hour eco-tour through the breathtaking Tampa Bay Estuary.
experiences.notes: Cruises page: 'PLEASE NOTE: WE ARE CLOSED FOR MAINTENANCE FROM APRIL 24 TO MAY 3' (year not stated). Prices on the booking widget, not on the pages read.

experiences.name: Tampa Bay Watch Discovery Center Wildlife Boat Tours
experiences.address: 400 2nd Ave NE, Slip Q47, St. Petersburg, FL 33701
experiences.departs_text: Eco-vessel Discovery at Gate 23, St. Petersburg Municipal Marina, on the St. Pete Pier approach (not at the Discovery Center itself).
experiences.duration_text: Wildlife tour 90 min; Liquid to Land history tour 120 min; sandbar snorkeling 120 min; sunset tour 60 min
experiences.price_text: Starting prices: Wildlife Boat Tour $20; Sunset Tour $18; Sandbar Snorkeling $26; Liquid to Land History Tour $45.
experiences.season_text: Wildlife, sunset and history tours year round; sandbar snorkeling seasonally.
experiences.ages_text: Sandbar snorkeling ages 5 and up, with an adult.
experiences.summary: Marine science educators from the nonprofit Tampa Bay Watch run wildlife tours on a floating classroom that include a fisheries trawl and citizen-science data collection, plus sunset, history and sandbar snorkeling trips. Proceeds support bay restoration.
experiences.quote: Every wildlife tour aboard the Discovery includes wildlife watching, a fisheries trawl to take a closer look at common local species, and an opportunity to participate in real scientific research.
experiences.notes: Tours are wheelchair accessible on request (email 24 hours ahead). The same page lists guided kayak tours departing Tampa Bay Watch headquarters in Tierra Verde (no price given).

experiences.name: Pier Dolphin Cruises (Dolphin Queen)
experiences.address: 400 2nd Ave NE, Gate 22, St. Petersburg, FL 33701
experiences.departs_text: Gate 22, St. Pete Municipal Marina, on the Pier access road about 100 yards east of Fresco's Waterfront Bistro.
experiences.schedule_text: Dolphin tours and sunset tours; custom eco tours for groups.
experiences.summary: Narrated dolphin and sunset tours on the Dolphin Queen, a shaded 49-passenger catamaran with a restroom, past Bird Island, the Coast Guard base and waterfront mansions. The operator guarantees a dolphin sighting or your next trip is free.
experiences.quote: For over 30 years, local dolphins have become familiar with the Dolphin Queen, often swimming alongside our bow and playing beside the boat
experiences.notes: FAQ: not wheelchair accessible; no pets or service animals on public tours; no outside food or drink on public tours. Founded 1992 per the team page. Prices are on the booking system, not the pages read.

experiences.name: The Pelican Egmont Key Boat Tour
experiences.address: 400 2nd Ave NE, Dock Q48, Gate 24, St. Petersburg, FL 33701
experiences.departs_text: St. Pete Pier area: Dock Q48, Gate 24, 400 2nd Avenue NE.
experiences.duration_text: 4 hours: about 1 hour each way plus about 2 hours on Egmont Key
experiences.price_text: Adults $69; children 12 and under $49.
experiences.summary: A 60-foot passenger boat runs from downtown St. Petersburg under the Sunshine Skyway Bridge to Egmont Key, where you get about two hours to swim, snorkel (gear provided) and walk to the Fort Dade ruins and lighthouse. The boat stays docked at the island, which has no restrooms or drinking water.
experiences.quote: Unlike the ferry, The Pelican will remain docked at the island for you to have access to our facilities, as the island does not have amenities like restrooms or drinking water.
experiences.notes: Alcohol, pets, drones, glass and kites are prohibited on Egmont Key (wildlife preserve), per the page. The Pelican also runs a dolphin sightseeing tour, a Sunset Skyway Bridge light show cruise and a Pine Key day trip (not separate records).

experiences.name: St. Pete Boat Tours Captained Pontoon Eco Tours
experiences.address: 101 Bayshore Dr NE, St. Petersburg, FL 33701
experiences.departs_text: St. Petersburg Municipal Marina, 101 Bayshore Drive NE, Slips Q10 and Q11.
experiences.price_text: Private captained 6-person pontoon: 2 hours $300; 3 hours $450; 4 hours $600.
experiences.schedule_text: Available 7 days a week.
experiences.summary: Private, captained pontoon trips for up to six from downtown St. Petersburg: two-hour sunset or wildlife runs past Bird Island and Snell Isle, or longer trips to Weedon Island, Shell Key or Egmont Key with time to snorkel or sit on a sandbar. Snorkel gear is provided.
experiences.quote: Our private Eco Tours are completely customizable, allowing you to choose activities such as island hopping, snorkeling, birding, or simply relaxing at a sandbar.

experiences.name: ECOmersion Weedon Island Kayak and Paddleboard Rentals and Tours
experiences.address: 1800 Weedon Dr NE, St. Petersburg, FL
experiences.departs_text: Weedon Island Preserve, 1800 Weedon Dr. NE.
experiences.price_text: Single kayak or paddleboard: 1 hour $28, 2 hours $45, 4 hours $55. Tandem kayak: 1 hour $40, 2 hours $70, 4 hours $80.
experiences.schedule_text: Park hours 9:00-5:00; rental hours depend on the tides.
experiences.ages_text: Recommended for ages 8-80.
experiences.summary: Kayak and stand-up paddleboard rentals and guided kayak tours in Weedon Island Preserve's mangrove tunnels. The tunnels need at least a foot of water, so check the tide; the operator often sells out and recommends booking ahead.
experiences.quote: Weedon Island is a 3,800 acre nature preserve located less than 20 minutes from downtown Tampa and St. Pete. It is a vital part of Tampa Bay, and has some of the longest mangrove tunnels on a contiguous paddling trail in the world!
experiences.notes: Sweetwater Kayaks also advertised Weedon Island rentals (sweetwaterkayaks.wordpress.com), but its main domain now shows unrelated spam and an 'Outdoor Center is Moving' notice, so its current status could not be confirmed and it was left out. Verifier 2026-09-27: Pinellas County's preserve page says the north paddling trail 'is closed at this time' (one of the two self-guided trails). The county's park updates page lists Weedon Island Preserve closed until 12 p.m. on Oct. 24, 2026 for a trail run.

experiences.name: Cruisin' Tikis St. Petersburg
experiences.departs_text: St. Pete Pier, 300 Second Ave NE, on the pier behind Fresco's (location given on the operator's booking page).
experiences.duration_text: St. Pete Pier Tiki Cruise 1 hour 30 minutes; private cruises 1.5 or 3 hours
experiences.ages_text: Ages 6+.
experiences.summary: Captained floating tiki-bar cruises around the St. Pete Pier and downtown St. Petersburg: book a seat on the 90-minute pier cruise or a private boat for up to six. Bring your own drinks and food; coolers, ice and a Bluetooth radio are provided.
experiences.notes: Verifier 2026-09-27: cruisintikis.com returns a bot challenge to curl, WebFetch and a reader proxy, so the prices and life-jacket rule reported earlier could not be confirmed and were removed. Durations, ages, capacity and the location are from the operator's own FareHarbor booking pages (company 'Cruisin' Tikis St. Petersburg').

experiences.name: Get Up and Go Kayaking Shell Key Preserve Clear Kayak Tours
experiences.departs_text: Tours launch from Tierra Verde, near St. Pete Beach.
experiences.duration_text: Glow tour 1.5 hours; private tour 3 hours
experiences.price_text: Shell Key clear kayak tour from $69; glow tour from $74; kayak and beach yoga from $79; private tour from $350.
experiences.ages_text: Glow tour ages 12+; private tour all ages.
experiences.summary: Guided tours in see-through kayaks to Shell Key Preserve's mangrove islands, beaches and sandbars, plus sunset and night 'glow' tours with LED-lit kayaks.
experiences.quote: Wildlife encounters at Shell Key Preserve vary by season. In the summer, look for manatees and pink Roseate Spoonbills. During the winter, White Pelicans gather along the sandbars.
experiences.notes: Street address 1 Collany Rd is from the Visit St. Pete/Clearwater profile; the operator's page says only Tierra Verde.

experiences.name: Speed Boat Adventures (St. Pete Beach)
experiences.address: 1901 Pass A Grille Way, St. Pete Beach, FL 33706
experiences.departs_text: 1901 Pass A Grille Way, St. Pete Beach.
experiences.summary: You drive your own small speedboat in a guided convoy past Fort De Soto Park and wildlife refuges, with narration over two-way radios.
experiences.notes: speedboatadventures.com returned a bot challenge to curl and WebFetch; facts are from the Visit St. Pete/Clearwater profile. Prices and minimum driver age (search snippets said 18) left null for the verifier.

experiences.name: Dolphin Racer Adventure Cruise
experiences.address: 3400 Pasadena Ave S, South Pasadena, FL 33707
experiences.departs_text: Corey Causeway dock (StarLite's St. Pete Beach area home port), 3400 Pasadena Ave. South; free parking in the operator's lot.
experiences.price_text: Adults (13+) $26.50; children (3-12) $16.50; infants 2 and under listed without a price.
experiences.ages_text: All ages.
experiences.summary: A 1.5- to 2-hour narrated sightseeing cruise from StarLite's Corey Causeway dock whose wake draws dolphins to surf and jump alongside. The operator offers a free next trip if dolphins do not surf or jump in the wake.
experiences.quote: We're proud to offer the Dolphin Racer Guarantee: if dolphins don't surf or jump in our wake, your next trip is free.
experiences.notes: The dock is on the mainland side of the Corey Causeway in South Pasadena; area set to st-pete-beach because the operator calls it the St. Pete Beach area. Vessel is only accessible by stairs.

experiences.name: Starlite Horizon Dining Yacht Cruises
experiences.address: 3400 Pasadena Ave S, South Pasadena, FL 33707
experiences.departs_text: Corey Causeway dock, 3400 Pasadena Ave. South; free parking.
experiences.price_text: Evening dining and daytime-with-music cruises from $29.95; daytime cruise from $24.95.
experiences.summary: Daytime and evening dining cruises aboard the 115-foot Starlite Horizon, with reserved-table dining, cocktails and a DJ.
experiences.quote: Set sail from St. Pete for a memorable evening of waterfront views, cocktails, DJ entertainment, dancing, and relaxed reserved-table dining aboard the Starlite Horizon.

experiences.name: Starlite Infinity Dining Yacht Cruises
experiences.departs_text: Clearwater Beach Marina, 25 Causeway Blvd. (the operator warns marina parking is extremely limited during construction).
experiences.price_text: Evening dining and daytime-with-music cruises from $29.95; daytime cruise from $24.95.
experiences.summary: Daytime and evening dining cruises on the Intracoastal Waterway aboard the Starlite Infinity, a 128-foot, five-deck yacht, with dining, drinks and a DJ.
experiences.quote: Step aboard the Starlite Infinity for a memorable evening of dining, drinks, DJ entertainment, dancing, and scenic Clearwater Intracoastal views from golden-hour beauty to starlit skies.
